$comment: Single source of truth mapping each P05 registration wizard type (apps/portal-web/app/assets/new/[type]/) to the real, already-validating manifest files it offers as examples. Read by two places that must stay in agreement: apps/portal-web/app/assets/new/[type]/examples/route.ts (serves them to the browser) and tests/contract/test_wizard_examples.py (proves they still validate against packages/schemas). Each type maps to a LIST because one type can have genuinely different starting points — an mcp_server reached over HTTP and one launched on the user's own PC share a schema but almost no fields. Paths are relative to the REPOSITORY ROOT, not to this file, so an example can point at a real sample project (samples/**) instead of a copy that silently drifts from it.
